name: io.github.Mehmoodqureshi/figma-mcp
title: figma-mcp
description: Figma to pixel-perfect code: deterministic HTML/React, then a render + pixel-diff verify loop.

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Figma personal access token (Settings -> Security -> Personal access tokens, scope "File content: read"). May instead be placed in a .figma-token file in the project directory. FIGMA_API_KEY is accepted as an alias.

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where converted frames are cached. Defaults to .figma-cache/ in the directory the server starts from.
